scope: Checks full sender, receiver, receiver application, congestion-state and drop inputs plus any recorded legacy cwnd, SRTT and sender-progress traces. Does not prove all loss paths are instrumented or generality to other scenarios.

execution_context.qualification: Simulation runtime excludes build, environment smoke check, analysis, hashing and plotting. Figure rendering was rerun but image-byte equality is not asserted. Deterministic replay is not an independent statistical repetition.
